distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) reported Sichuan (Dechang), Yunnan (Lijiang, Yongsheng, Simao, Xishuangbanna). Huang & Lu (2015) reported Sichuan, Yunnan. These are literature-based records; the regional occurrence assessment remains Candidate pending independent checklist review.

host_note: Host names are retained as reported in the cited literature. Each host is linked to its supporting source; 2015 may repeat 1984 evidence rather than provide an independent confirmation. Host associations have not yet been independently reviewed.
